I have been farming in Mwanza for many years and I know what works on this rented plot. Because the land is not my own, I will not spend money on expensive chemical fertilizer, but I will spread manure from my livestock to keep the soil fertile. I will plant improved cassava cuttings that the extension officer gave me last season because they stand up better against the diseases going around here. My family can do all the work ourselves—we do not need to hire anyone for a plot this small, and we will rely on the rains as we always do.
